'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 2 Aaron Nelson LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Nelson]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room]]

* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
